benchmark_name: OPPORTUNITY FACTORY V2 Independent Adversarial Benchmark
freeze_note: All 95 inputs, pathway challenge targets, and expected outcomes were authored and frozen before any execution against the application. This benchmark has not been executed.

scoring_policy.unambiguous: Exact pathway-set match; no-pathway cases require empty pathway set. Missing expected pathways are false negatives; extra pathways are false positives.
scoring_policy.ambiguous: Exclude from primary accuracy denominator; report separately with candidate pathways and uncertainty. Never force a label.
scoring_policy.unsupported_inference: Flag as inference/evidence failure even if pathway set matches.
scoring_policy.single_vs_multi: Report exact-set match and per-pathway precision/recall separately.

scenarios.input_description: A ceramics kiln is fired only on two shifts although the installed burners and crew roster can support three; a nearby tile maker has requested toll-firing slots.

expected_relationships: Loss may be abnormal process waste or an accepted technical tolerance
scenarios.supporting_rationale: The economic significance of the loss cannot be determined without an applicable baseline.
missing_information_and_uncertainty: Industry norm, product specification, measurement reliability, recovery cost

scenarios.input_description: A dairy cooperative has evening milk volumes that exceed its chilling slots; a nearby ice plant has unused night refrigeration and a retailer needs morning deliveries of chilled dairy. A shared milk-cooling hub model proven in Uruguay is being evaluated for this region, where no equivalent operator exists.
economic_facts_explicit: Evening milk volume exceeds cooperative chilling slots
Ice plant has unused night refrigeration
Shared milk-cooling hub model proven in Uruguay
expected_relationships: Ice plant night capacity can chill cooperative milk for retailer morning deliveries
scenarios.supporting_rationale: Three actors and time-compatible assets/needs form a specific service mechanism. A proven model from another market is explicitly being transferred to a target market, in addition to the spare-capacity, demand and integration mechanisms.
missing_information_and_uncertainty: Temperature standards, route distance, volumes, ownership of milk, price

scenarios.input_description: The quarry operation has been loss-making for three years; management is evaluating an operating turnaround by reconfiguring screening, recovering stockpiled fines, and supplying the road contractor.
economic_facts_explicit: Quarry operation has been loss-making for three years

Management proposes operational reconfiguration as turnaround

scenarios.supporting_rationale: A residual stream, buyer dependency, and separate process loss are explicitly linked to distinct mechanisms. The case contains an existing underperforming operation being reconfigured, alongside the resource, buyer and process mechanisms.
missing_information_and_uncertainty: Dust gradation, road standards, energy baseline, transport, contract volumes

scenarios.input_description: A hospital sterilization unit runs overnight for emergency loads, while elective surgery packs are sterilized in daytime batches that cause queueing; another hospital has spare validated night capacity and a shared courier route. expected_relationships: Hospital B night capacity and courier route can process Hospital A packs

scenarios.input_description: A fish auction has unsold low-grade catch at closing; the catch is discarded after four hours because dispatch is not coordinated. A nearby protein ingredient plant can process it, and a cold-chain operator has return capacity after delivering ice to the port.

Catch is discarded after four hours due to dispatch cutoff

scenarios.input_description: A loss-making glass recycler is evaluating an operational turnaround: manual color sorting loses cullet, a neighboring ceramics maker can use mixed-color fines, and a proven fines-recovery line from another country is available for adaptation.
